access_classes.public: Anyone on the internet; the entry point's own limits protect it.
access_classes.signed_webhook: A provider (messaging, voice, telephony, payments) proving itself with its signature, secret token or handshake before anything is parsed.
access_classes.customer: A business's customer: the website chat (the visitor's own key and the business's allowed origins), the hosted chat, or a signed link from a message (manage booking, review, calendar feed).
access_classes.account: Any signed-in person, on their own account only (profile, sessions, authenticators, their businesses and brands, creating one).
access_classes.staff: A member of the business: staff, an agency the owner let in, a brand's regional manager on their locations, and the owner.
access_classes.owner: The business's owner (or the brand's owner); staff get 403.
access_classes.platform_admin: A platform admin signed in with two factors, holding the permission of their admin role (super, support_readonly, billing).
access_classes.api_key: A business's public API key; a cabinet session token is refused.
access_classes.as_api: The cabinet's proxy: forwards /v1/* with the session's token, so the API operation's own class applies.
access_classes.worker: Run by the background worker on its schedule, or from the queue the platform's own use cases fill after authorizing the request; no outside caller.
access_classes.operator_shell: A command of the backend image, run by Render (service start, cron) or by a person with shell access to the service.

commands.name: workshop migrate
commands.summary: Apply the SQL migrations in `migrations/` to the database in DATABASE_URL.

commands.name: workshop migrate-documents
commands.summary: Rewrite stored documents of older schema versions in the current shape.

commands.name: workshop backfill-lookup
commands.summary: Fill trigger-kept lookup columns for rows written before their migration.

commands.name: workshop seed-load
commands.summary: Store a load-test dataset and write the manifest the load tests read.

commands.name: workshop purge-audit-log
commands.summary: Remove audit log entries older than a retention period, keeping every hash chain verifiable.

commands.name: workshop backup
commands.summary: Back up the database off-site: a consistent pg_dump, encrypted with age to BACKUP_AGE_PUBLIC_KEY, uploaded to the EU bucket of BACKUP_S3_*; then the retention keeps 30 daily and 12 monthly copies (BACKUP_KEEP_*).

commands.name: workshop restore-check
commands.summary: The restore drill: restore the newest off-site backup into a throwaway database and prove it is complete and safe.
